title: Worm's eye
purpose: The camera on the ground looking up. The most extreme angle the studio will perform.

build.action: the place as it is, alive

cannot: the angle in a place with no straight verticals (a harbour of masts cannot be measured)
a figure (past a steep angle the eye-level cutout stops reading; the entry is for the place alone)
the figure seen from below (the pack's low view is foreshortened and the compositor sizes by total height, so it lands as a big head on a short body - the place is angled, the person is not)
measured: pitch +0.75, at the clamp; past 0.8 the keystone eats the frame
hint: The camera on the ground looking up. The most extreme angle the studio will perform.
